# OPtions for reassortment inference 

- treesort

# TreeSort 
- re-download fasta files for treesort - include a different name schema than for nextstrain builds `sample_ID|date`. modify fludb accession download scripts to incorperate segments and headers 

## Prepare dataset with provided curation scripts
```{shell}
./prepare_dataset.sh --fast --segments "HA,NA" tutorial/swH1-dataset/swine_H1_HANA.fasta HA tutorial/swH1-parsed
```

## generate descriptor file

## strain names need to have dates within the name...
```{shell}
treesort \
    -i config/vic/treesort_descriptor.csv \
    -o results/treesort/ibv-ha.annotated.tre \
    -m mincut
```
